blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Applying South Africa's draft R3337 warning criteria to food-package photographs requires nutrition, ingredient and product-form evidence. This study presents a region-guided evidence extraction and abstention-aware screening workflow for draft R3337. A three-class detector localises nutrition information panels, ingredient lists and product-identity regions, after which PaddleOCR and structured extraction recover nutrient values, ingredient evidence and product-form information. Recovered evidence is aggregated and assessed using deterministic draft R3337 rules. When evidence is incomplete, uncertain or conflicting, the workflow abstains through Review or Insufficient evidence rather than forcing an automatic outcome. For qualifying unresolved cases, a selective vision-language model (VLM) review stage using Qwen3-VL 8B Instruct reassesses unresolved evidence. Accepted evidence is merged and the same deterministic rules are reapplied. The workflow was applied to 442 products represented by 3,929 images. Evaluation used a manual validation set of 65 products. Before selective VLM review, 31 of 60 decidable products received automatic outcomes and 30 were correct, giving 51.7% coverage and 96.8% accuracy among automatic outcomes (selective accuracy). Selective VLM review resolved eight additional products, increasing coverage to 65.0%. Of 39 automatic outcomes, 38 were correct, giving 97.4% selective accuracy. The single false warning was retained from the rules-only workflow, while no unsafe warning omissions occurred after selective review. Evidence-level evaluation nevertheless identified incorrect VLM-recovered nutrition, ingredient and product-form evidence. These findings show that selective VLM review can recover unresolved evidence, while deterministic screening and explicit abstention remain necessary for reliable image-based draft R3337 screening.
blocks.zh: 将南非的R3337预警标准草案适用于食品包装照片需要营养、成分和产品形式的证据。 这项研究为R3337草案提供了一个区域指导的证据提取和弃权式筛选工作流程。 一个三级探测器将营养信息面板,成分清单和产品识别区域本地化,之后PaddleOCR和结构化提取恢复营养值,成分证据和产品形式信息. 利用R3337规则草案对已收回的证据进行汇总和评估。 当证据不完整、不确定或相互冲突时,工作流程通过审查或证据不足而放弃,而不是强迫自动结果。 对于未解决的案件,采用Qune3-VL 8B的选择性视觉语言模型(VLM)审查阶段,指示重新评估未解决的证据。 接受的证据被合并,同样的确定性规则重新适用。 该工作流程应用于以3 929幅图像为代表的442种产品。 评价采用由65个产品组成的人工验证组。 在选择性VLM审查之前,60种可决定产品中有31种获得自动结果,30种正确,自动结果的覆盖率为51.7%,准确度为96.8%(选择性准确性)。 选择性的VLM审查解决了另外8种产品,覆盖率提高到65.0%. 在39个自动结果中,38个正确,给予97.4%的选择性准确性。 仅从规则工作流程中保留了单一的虚假警告,而选择性审查后没有出现不安全的警告遗漏。 然而,证据一级的评价查明了未收回的VLM营养、成分和产品形式的证据。 这些调查结果表明,有选择的VLM审查可以收回未解决的证据,而确定性筛选和明确弃权对于基于图像的可靠草案R3337筛选仍然是必要的。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Front-of-pack labelling (FOPL) is intended to make important nutrition information more visible to consumers at the point of purchase. The World Health Organization [ 20 ] identifies FOPL as a policy tool that can support healthier food choices. Bopape et al. [ 5 ] found that South African consumers viewed warning labels positively and described them as concise and understandable. The Department of Health [ 7 ] published the Draft Regulations Relating to the Labelling and Advertising of Foodstuffs (R3337), which propose front-of-pack warning symbols for prepackaged foods that meet specified conditions relating to total sugar, saturated fat, sodium and artificial sweeteners. Applying these criteria requires nutrient values, evidence of added nutrient sources, product form and, where applicable, nutrition information after preparation.
blocks.zh: 前包装标签(FOPL)旨在让消费者在购买时更清楚地看到重要的营养信息. 世界卫生组织[20]将FOPL确定为支持健康食品选择的政策工具. 博帕佩等人著. [5] 发现南非消费者对警告标签持积极评价,并称其简明易懂. 卫生部[7]公布了《食品标签和广告条例草案》(R3337),为预包装食品提出前包装警告符号,这些食品符合与糖总、饱和脂肪、钠和人工甜剂有关的特定条件。 应用这些标准需要营养值、增加营养来源的证据、产品形式,以及适当的营养信息。

blocks.en: Previous South African draft R3337 assessments used captured or manually coded product information [ 2 , 14 ] , whereas direct screening from food-package photographs first requires the relevant evidence to be recovered from the images. The information required for screening may appear across several photographs and package surfaces, while small text, dense layouts, glare, curved packaging and other image conditions can affect text recognition. Recognising package text alone is also insufficient. Nutrient names must be associated with the correct values, units and reference bases, while ingredient and product-form evidence must be recovered and combined at product level. Image-derived evidence may be incomplete, uncertain or conflicting, making it unsafe to force an automatic screening outcome when the required evidence cannot be established reliably.
blocks.zh: 南非先前的R3337评估草案使用了捕获或人工编码的产品信息[2、14],而直接从食品包装照片中筛选则首先需要从图像中找到相关证据。 筛选所需的信息可能出现在多个照片和包表面,而小文本,密集布局,光泽,曲线包装和其他图像条件会影响文本识别. 仅承认一揽子案文是不够的。 营养品名称必须与正确的值,单位和参考依据相联系,而成分和产品形式的证据必须在产品一级进行回收和合并. 图像生成的证据可能不完整、不确定或相互冲突,在所需证据无法可靠地证实时,强迫自动筛选结果可能不安全。

blocks.en: This study develops an integrated region-guided, abstention-aware workflow for screening food-package images against draft R3337. It combines region localisation, optical character recognition (OCR), structured evidence extraction, deterministic screening and selective vision-language model (VLM) review, while retaining Review or Insufficient evidence when evidence remains unresolved. The main contributions of this study are as follows:
blocks.zh: 这项研究开发了一个区域指导、不知情的综合工作流程,以对照R3337草案筛选食品包装图像。 它结合了区域本地化,光学字符识别(OCR),结构化的证据提取,决定性筛选和选择性的视觉语言模型(VLM)审查,同时在证据尚未解决时保留审查或证据不足. 这项研究的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: 1. A region-guided workflow for recovering and integrating nutrition, ingredient and product-form evidence from real South African food-package photographs. 2. A deterministic implementation of the draft R3337 warning criteria with explicit abstention when image-derived evidence is incomplete, uncertain or conflicting. 3. A selective VLM evidence-review stage that reassesses qualifying unresolved evidence before deterministic rule reapplication. 4. A product-level evaluation of the proposed screening workflow against manual reference outcomes, together with an evidence-level evaluation of the reliability of VLM-recovered nutrition, ingredient and product-form evidence.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 由区域指导的工作流程,从南非食品包装照片中恢复和综合营养、成分和产品形式的证据。 2. 在图像生成的证据不完整、不确定或相互冲突时明确弃权执行R3337预警标准草案。 3. 有选择的自愿终止措施证据审查阶段,在重新适用确定性规则之前重新评估未解决的证据。 4. 对照人工参考结果对拟议的筛选工作流程进行产品级评价,同时对通过VLM回收的营养、成分和产品形式证据的可靠性进行证据级评价。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Front-of-Pack Warning Labels and Draft R3337 Assessment
blocks.zh: 2.1 包头警告标签和R3337评估草案

blocks.en: Nutrient profiling models classify packaged foods according to their nutritional composition and nutrients of concern. Frank et al. [ 8 ] applied four nutrient profiling models to the South African packaged-food supply and found that classifications differed across the models. Draft R3337 specifies warning criteria based on total sugar, saturated fat, sodium and artificial sweeteners, together with conditions relating to added nutrient sources, product form and, where applicable, prepared-product values [ 7 ] . Abdool Karim et al. [ 2 ] used coded package and nutrition variables from 6,768 photographed products to determine warning-label eligibility and assess on-package marketing under draft R3337. Mamabolo et al. [ 14 ] assessed 271 breakfast porridges and cereals and found that warning-label requirements varied with preparation method and grain type. These studies show the importance of nutrient, ingredient and preparation-related evidence, but did not automate its recovery from food-package photographs.
blocks.zh: 营养素特征分析模型根据包装食品的营养成分和值得关注的营养成分进行分类. 弗兰克等人. [8] 对南非包装食品供应采用了四个营养素特征分析模型,发现各模型的分类不同. R3337草案规定了基于糖总、饱和脂肪、钠和人造甜剂的警告标准,以及与添加的营养来源、产品形式和适用的预制产品值有关的条件[7]。 Abdool Karim等人著 [2] 使用6,768张照片产品中的编码包装和营养变量,以确定警告标签资格,并评估R3337草案下的包装上销售。 Mamabolo等人著. [14] 评估了271份早餐粥和谷物,发现在制备方法和谷物类型方面对警告标签的要求各不相同。 这些研究表明营养素,成分和制备相关证据的重要性,但没有使其从食品包装照片中的回收自动化.

blocks.en: 2.2 Food-Package Evidence Recovery
blocks.zh: 2.2 食品包装证据回收

blocks.en: Food-package photographs present challenges that differ from scanned documents, including curved and reflective surfaces, visually crowded layouts and uncontrolled image conditions. Guimarães et al. [ 11 ] reviewed grocery-label detection and recognition and identified product variation, limited datasets and uncontrolled image conditions. Nagayi et al. [ 16 ] evaluated four OCR systems on real South African food-package images and identified dense layouts, multilingual text, glare, curved surfaces and small text as packaging-specific challenges. Their evaluation focused on text recovery, while Nagayi et al. [ 15 ] combined region detection, OCR-derived sodium evidence, product identification and deterministic R214 screening.
blocks.zh: 食品包装照片提出了不同于扫描文件的挑战,包括曲线和反射面、视觉拥挤的布局和不受控制的图像条件。 吉马良等. [11] 审查杂货标签检测和识别,并查明产品差异、有限的数据集和不受控制的图像条件。 纳加伊等人. [16] 在真实的南非食品包装图象上评价了四个OCR系统,并确定密集布局、多语种文本、光泽、曲线表面和小文本是包装特有的挑战。 他们的评价侧重于文本的恢复,而Nagayi等人则侧重于文本的恢复。 [15] 结合区域检测,OCR衍生的钠证据,产品识别和确定R214筛选.

blocks.en: Region localisation can reduce irrelevant package content before text recognition. Saputra et al. [ 18 ] used a MobileNetV1-based detector to locate nutrition-label regions before applying preprocessing and Tesseract OCR. Their evaluation was limited to ten images and focused on extracting text from nutrition labels. Fuentes et al. [ 9 ] developed an OCR-based system that preserved spatial relationships between nutrient names and quantities when extracting nutritional information from Spanish food products. Their approach demonstrates the importance of retaining layout information when associating nutrient labels with the correct values. Pettersson et al. [ 17 ] combined visual features with OCR-derived text for fine-grained grocery-product recognition and found that the two information sources complemented each other. Food-package evidence recovery therefore involves more than isolated text recognition and can depend on region localisation, spatial association and integration of visual and textual information.
blocks.zh: 区域本地化可以在文本识别之前减少不相关的包内容. Saputra等人[18]使用基于MobileNetV1的探测器,在应用预处理和魔方OCR之前确定营养标签区的位置。 他们的评价仅限于10幅图像,并侧重于从营养标签中提取文本. 富恩特斯等人著. [9] 开发了一个基于OCR的系统,在从西班牙食品中提取营养信息时,保持营养名称与数量之间的空间关系. 他们的做法表明,在将营养标签与正确值挂钩时,保留布局信息十分重要。 佩特尔松等. [17] 视觉特征与OCR派生的文字结合,用于精细的杂货产品识别,发现两个信息来源相辅相成. 因此,食品包装证据的恢复涉及的不仅仅是孤立的文本识别,还取决于区域本地化、空间联系和视觉和文本信息的整合。

blocks.en: 2.3 Vision-Language Models, Reliability and Selective Prediction
blocks.zh: 2.3 远景-语言模型、可靠性和选择性预测

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can perform text recognition, visual question answering and structured information extraction from image and text inputs. Liu et al. [ 13 ] evaluated multimodal models using OCRBench across text-related image tasks and reported useful capabilities alongside continuing weaknesses in multilingual and other challenging text settings. Assiri et al. [ 3 ] evaluated multimodal language models for extracting nutritional elements and values from bilingual food-label images, demonstrating their relevance to food-package information extraction. The Qwen3-VL family described by Bai et al. [ 4 ] supports combined image and text inputs and includes an 8-billion-parameter variant. However, performance on general benchmarks or related extraction tasks does not establish reliable recovery of exact nutrient values, units, reference bases and ingredient evidence from real food-package images. Selective prediction provides an approach for handling uncertain model outputs. Geifman and El-Yaniv [ 10 ] introduced SelectiveNet, which jointly considers prediction and rejection while examining coverage and error risk. Whitehead et al. [ 19 ] applied abstention to visual question answering, where withholding an answer was preferred when confidence was insufficient. These studies show the value of allowing uncertain cases to remain unresolved rather than requiring a prediction for every input. In evidence-extraction settings, however, abstention does not establish that the evidence returned is factually correct. The reliability of recovered evidence therefore remains important alongside coverage and abstention.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)可以进行文本识别,视觉问题回答和结构化信息从图像和文本输入中提取. 刘等. [13] 利用OCR Bench在文本相关图像任务中评价了多式联运模型,并报告了在多语种文本和其他具有挑战性的文本设置中继续存在的弱点的同时的有用能力。 阿西里等人著. [3] 评估了从双语食品标签图象中提取营养元素和价值的多式联运语言模型,显示了它们与食品包装信息提取的相关性。 Bai等人描述的Quen3-VL家族. [4]支持合并图像和文本输入,并包括一个80亿参数的变体. 然而,在一般基准或相关提取任务上的表现并不能可靠地从真实的食品包装图像中恢复准确的营养值、单位、参考依据和成分证据。 选择性预测提供了处理不确定模型输出的方法. Geifman和El-Yaniv[10]引入了SelectiveNet,该网在检查覆盖范围和错误风险时共同考虑预测和拒绝. 白头等人. [19] 对视觉问题的回答投了弃权票,在信心不足时,最好不予回答。 这些研究显示,允许不确定案件得不到解决,而不是要求对每一项投入作出预测,是有价值的。 然而,在取证情况下,弃权并不证明所交回的证据事实上是正确的。 因此,除了覆盖范围和弃权之外,收回证据的可靠性仍然很重要。

blocks.en: 2.4 Research Gap
blocks.zh: 2.4 研究差距

blocks.en: Previous work has addressed draft R3337 assessment, food-package OCR and region localisation, structured nutrition extraction, multimodal food-label extraction and selective prediction. Nagayi et al. [ 15 ] integrated image-derived evidence for R214 sodium screening, but not the broader nutrition, ingredient and product-form evidence required for draft R3337. The reviewed studies do not evaluate draft R3337 screening with explicit abstention and selective VLM review. The contribution is therefore the system-level integration and evaluation of these components rather than the development of a new detector or VLM architecture.
blocks.zh: 以前的工作涉及R3337评估草案、食品包装OCR和区域本地化、结构化的营养提取、多式食品标签提取和选择性预测。 纳加伊等人. [15] R214钠筛查综合图像衍生证据,但不包括R3337草案所需的更广泛的营养,成分和产品形式证据. 经审查的研究报告没有以明确弃权的方式评价R3337筛选草案和有选择的VLM审查。 因此,贡献在于这些组件的系统层面整合和评价,而不是开发一个新的探测器或VLM架构.

blocks.en: 3 Dataset Description
blocks.zh: 3 数据集描述

blocks.en: 3.1 Food-Package Screening Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 食品包装筛选数据集

blocks.en: The study uses real-world food-package photographs from the South African Nutrition Facts Panel project of the Department of Dietetics and Nutrition at the University of the Western Cape (UWC). The photographs were collected in 2023 by trained personnel. The screening dataset contains 442 packaged-food products represented by 3,929 full-package photographs. Each product is represented by between three and twenty-seven photographs, averaging 8.9 photographs per product. The photographs capture different package surfaces, meaning that product identity, nutrition information, ingredient information and preparation details may appear in different images of the same product. The product is the unit of analysis. All photographs are linked to their corresponding product and are treated as sources of information rather than as independent samples. The screening dataset is separate from the annotated dataset used to develop and evaluate the region detector described in Section 3.2.
blocks.zh: 这项研究使用了西开普大学饮食和营养系南非营养事实小组项目中的真实世界食品包装照片。 照片于2023年由训练有素的人员收集. 筛选数据集包含442个包装食品产品,代表为3,929个完整包装照片. 每个产品以三至二十七张照片为代表,平均每件产品有8.9张照片。 照片捕捉到不同的包表面,这意味着产品身份,营养信息,成分信息和制备细节可能出现在同一产品的不同图像中. 产品是分析的单位. 所有照片都与其相应的产品相联系,并作为信息来源而不是作为独立的样本处理。 筛选数据集与用于开发和评价第3.2节所述区域探测器的附加说明数据集是分开的。

blocks.en: 3.2 Detector-Development Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.2 探测器-开发数据集

blocks.en: For detector development, 664 annotated food-package images from 176 products were used, containing 885 bounding boxes across three classes, namely nutrition information panels, ingredient lists and product-identity regions. The annotations comprised 201 nutrition-panel regions, 274 ingredient-list regions and 410 product-identity regions. The dataset was divided at product level into training, validation and held-out test subsets with an approximately 80%, 10% and 10% split. The training subset contained 141 products (80.1%), 524 images and 700 bounding boxes. The validation subset contained 18 products (10.2%), 89 images and 120 bounding boxes, while the held-out test subset contained 17 products (9.7%), 51 images and 65 bounding boxes. No product appeared in more than one subset, ensuring that evaluated products were not represented during training.
blocks.zh: 在探测器开发方面,使用了来自176个产品的664个附加说明的食品包装图像,其中包括885个捆绑箱,分为三个类别,即营养信息面板、成分清单和产品识别区域。 说明包括201个营养小组区域、274个成分清单区域和410个产品标识区域。 数据集在产品一级分为培训、验证和停产测试子集,分得大约80%、10%和10%。 培训子集包括141个产品(80.1%)、524个图像和700个捆绑箱。 鉴定子集包含18个产品(10.2%),89个图像和120个捆绑箱,而搁置测试子集包含17个产品(9.7%),51个图像和65个捆绑箱. 一个以上的子集没有出现任何产品,确保培训期间没有代表被评价的产品。

blocks.en: 4 Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Overall Workflow
blocks.zh: 4.1 总体工作流量

blocks.en: The proposed methodology consists of an initial region-guided screening workflow followed by selective VLM evidence review for qualifying unresolved evidence. Figure 1 presents the initial stages from the food-package images described in Section 3 through region detection, optical character recognition (OCR), evidence extraction and deterministic draft R3337 screening.
blocks.zh: 拟议的方法包括初步的区域指导筛选工作流程,然后对未解决的证据进行选择性的核实、报告和核实证据审查。 图1显示从第3节所述食品包装图象到区域探测、光学特征识别(OCR)、证据提取和确定性R3337筛选的初步阶段。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Initial region-guided evidence extraction and deterministic draft R3337 screening workflow.
blocks.zh: 图1:初步区域指导证据提取和确定R3337筛选工作流程草案。

blocks.en: 1. Input. The workflow receives the full-package photographs associated with each product. 2. Region detection. A three-class detector localises nutrition information panels, ingredient lists and product-identity regions. 3. OCR and evidence extraction. Region-guided OCR recovers nutrition, ingredient and product-form evidence, while unresolved evidence is retained. 4. Deterministic draft R3337 screening. Product-level evidence is assessed using the encoded rules without forcing outcomes when required evidence remains uncertain or unavailable. 5. Initial rules-only outcomes. Products are assigned Warning criteria met , No warning criteria triggered , Review or Insufficient evidence , with the latter two representing abstention.

blocks.en: 4.2 Region Detection and Optical Character Recognition
blocks.zh: 4.2 区域探测和光学特征识别

blocks.en: The annotated detector-development dataset described in Section 3.2 is used to train a three-class You Only Look Once version 26 small (YOLO26s) object detector from pretrained weights using Ultralytics version 8.4.89 [ 12 ] . Training uses automatic optimiser selection, deterministic execution with a seed of 0 and automatic mixed-precision computation. The checkpoint selected at epoch 77 based on validation performance is retained for evaluation on the held-out test subset and inference on the food-package screening dataset. During inference, images are processed at an input size of 640 × 640 640\times 640 pixels using a confidence threshold of 0.25. Each retained detection preserves the product and source-image identifiers, region class, bounding-box coordinates and detector confidence.
blocks.zh: 第3.2节中描述的附加说明的探测器-开发数据集用于训练一个三等的You Only Look Once 26版小(YOLO26s)对象探测器,使用超强性能的8.4.89 [12] 版本从预先训练的重量. 训练使用自动选手选择,定型执行,种子为0,自动混合精度计算. 根据验证性能在77世纪选定的检查站被保留下来,用于对搁置的测试子集和食品包装筛选数据集的推论进行评价。 在推论期间,图像的处理采用0.25的置信阈值,输入大小为640×640640\时640像素. 每次保留检测都保留产品和源图像标识符,区域级,边框坐标和检测器信心.

blocks.en: OCR is applied to the detected nutrition-panel, ingredient-list and product-identity regions using PaddleOCR version 3.5.0 with the graphics processing unit (GPU) build of PaddlePaddle version 3.3.0 [ 6 ] . The configuration uses the PP-OCRv5_server_det text-detection model, the en_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec English recognition model and the PP-LCNet_x1_0_textline_ori text-line-orientation model, with text-line orientation enabled. Recognised text from ingredient-list and product-identity regions is retained with its product and source-image information, while nutrition-panel outputs retain recognised tokens and their coordinates for structured extraction. Each nutrition-panel region is processed in its original form and in a second rendering produced by adding approximately 10% padding and enlarging the padded region by a factor of two. Source photographs, detected crops, alternative renderings and OCR outputs remain linked to the originating product and are not treated as independent product samples.
blocks.zh: OCR应用于PaddleOCR版本3.5.0的检测到的营养小板,成分列表和产品识别区域,并配有PaddlePaddle版本3.3.0 [6]的图形处理单元(GPU)构建. 配置使用 PP-OCRv5_server_det文本检测模型,en_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec 英语识别模式和PP-LCNet_x1_0_textline_ori文本线定向模式,启用文本线定向. 其产品和源图像信息保留了来自成份清单和产品识别区域的经确认文本,而营养小区产出保留了经确认的标志及其坐标,以便进行有条理的提取。 每个营养小板区都以原始形式和第二次渲染方式加工,增加约10%的粘贴剂,并增加两个系数。 原始照片、检测到的作物、替代渲染物和OCR输出物仍与原产物有关,不作为独立产品样品处理。

blocks.en: 4.3 Structured Evidence Extraction and Product-Level Aggregation
blocks.zh: 4.3 结构证据提取和产品一级聚合

blocks.en: Nutrition evidence. Recognised nutrition-panel tokens and their coordinates are processed using a header-aware, coordinate-based extractor that associates nutrient labels with numerical values, units and reference bases. Candidate values are identified using nutrient-label matching, row proximity and table-header interpretation. The warning-related targets are total sugar, saturated fat and sodium, while total fat is retained as supporting information rather than assessed as a draft R3337 warning component. Consistency checks across the original and padded renderings consider nutrient identity, numerical value, unit and reference basis. Evidence remains unresolved when the row association, value, unit or reference basis cannot be established reliably, or when renderings or nutrition panels produce conflicts. Salt values are retained separately and are not compared directly with sodium thresholds. When an explicit sodium value is unavailable, salt-derived sodium evidence is accepted only when the conversion, unit and applicable per-100 reference basis are clear. Preparation information is considered where available, but evidence remains unresolved when the applicable basis cannot be established reliably.
blocks.zh: 营养证据. 识别的营养小板标志及其坐标使用一个标头-意识、以协调为基础的提取器处理,该提取器将营养标签与数值、单位和参考基准联系起来。 候选人的数值通过营养标签匹配、行近和桌头解释确定。 与警告相关的目标是糖总,饱和脂肪和钠,而总脂肪则保留作为佐证信息,而不是作为R3337预警组件草案进行评估. 横跨原始和添加渲染的一致性检查考虑营养特性、数值、单位和参考依据。 当无法可靠地确定行协会、价值、单位或参考基础,或当制作或营养板造成冲突时,证据仍未解决。 盐值单独保留,不直接与钠阈值进行比较. 当没有明确的钠值时,只有在转换、单位和适用的每100个参考依据清楚的情况下,才接受盐衍生的钠证据。 如果有准备资料,则予以考虑,但在无法可靠地确定适用依据时,证据仍未解决。

blocks.en: Ingredient evidence. Recognised text from ingredient-list regions is grouped by product and searched using deterministic term dictionaries and text-matching rules. The categories cover added sugar, added sodium, added saturated-fat sources and artificial sweeteners. Added saturated-fat evidence is restricted to qualifying dictionary terms and does not include every ingredient that may naturally contain saturated fat. Each category is assigned Yes , Not detected or Uncertain . Yes indicates that a configured qualifying term is identified in recognised text. Not detected indicates that no configured term is found and is not interpreted as proof that the ingredient is absent. Uncertain is assigned when recognised text or the match cannot support a clear result. Missing ingredient-list regions and empty OCR outputs remain unavailable evidence.
blocks.zh: 摄入之证. 来自成份列表区域的公认文本按产品分类,并使用定语词典和文本匹配规则进行搜索。 类别包括添加糖,添加钠,添加饱和脂肪源和人工甜剂. 添加的饱和脂肪证据仅限于限定词典术语,并不包括可能自然含有饱和脂肪的所有成分. 每个类别被指定是、未检测或不确定。 是表示在确认的文本中指明了已配置的限定词。 未检测到的表示没有找到已配置的术语,也没有被解释为没有成分的证据. 当识别文本或匹配无法支持明确结果时,会指定不确定。 缺少成份清单的地区和OCR的空产出仍未获得证据。

blocks.en: Product form and product-level aggregation. Product form is determined from product-identity information and package text, as the applicable draft R3337 nutrient thresholds differ for solid and liquid products. The product-form assessment returns Solid , Liquid or Review , with Review retained when the available information is insufficient or conflicting. Recovered nutrition, ingredient and product-form evidence is aggregated at product level. Where evidence remains missing, uncertain or conflicting across available sources, that uncertainty is preserved rather than resolved by forcing a value or classification. The product-level evidence is passed to deterministic draft R3337 screening in Section 4.4.
blocks.zh: 产品形式和产品级汇总. 产品形式根据产品识别信息和包装文本确定,因为适用的R3337营养阈值草案对固体和液体产品不同。 产品形式评估返回固体、液体或审查,当现有信息不足或相互冲突时保留审查。 恢复的营养、成分和产品形式的证据在产品一级汇总。 在证据仍然缺失、不确定或现有来源之间相互冲突的情况下,这种不确定性得到保留,而不是通过强迫价值或分类来解决。 第4.4节将产品一级的证据传递给确定性R3337筛选草案。

blocks.en: 4.4 Deterministic Draft R3337 Screening and Abstention
blocks.zh: 4.4 确定性R3337筛选和搁置草案

blocks.en: The product-level evidence produced in Section 4.3 is assessed using deterministic rules that operationalise the draft R3337 warning criteria. For consistent implementation, the study applies nutrient-specific conjunctive rules to total sugar, saturated fat and sodium. A nutrient-related warning requires both qualifying added-source evidence for the corresponding nutrient and a nutrient value greater than the applicable solid or liquid threshold. The implementation uses strict greater-than comparisons consistent with the draft R3337 nutrient cut-offs [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 第4.3节提出的产品一级证据是使用R3337预警标准草案的确定规则加以评估的。 为了一致执行,该研究对糖总,饱和脂肪和钠适用营养特异性结合规则. 与养分有关的警告要求具备相应的养分补充源证据和高于适用的固体或液体阈值的养分值。 实施工作采用了与R3337营养素截断草案相一致的严格比比较[7].

blocks.en: For solid products, the encoded thresholds are: • total sugar greater than 10.0 g per 100 g. • saturated fat greater than 4.0 g per 100 g. • sodium greater than 400 mg per 100 g.
blocks.zh: 对于固体产品,编码阈值为: •总糖大于每100克10.0克; •饱和脂肪大于每100克4.0克; 钠大于每100克400毫克.

blocks.en: total sugar greater than 10.0 g per 100 g.
blocks.zh: 糖总含量大于每100克10.0克。

blocks.en: saturated fat greater than 4.0 g per 100 g.
blocks.zh: 饱和脂肪大于每100克4.0克.

blocks.en: sodium greater than 400 mg per 100 g.
blocks.zh: 每100克大于400毫克的钠.

blocks.en: For liquid products, the encoded thresholds are: • total sugar greater than 5.0 g per 100 ml. • saturated fat greater than 3.0 g per 100 ml. • sodium greater than 100 mg per 100 ml.
blocks.zh: 对于液体产品,编码阈值为: • 总糖大于每100毫升5.0克. • 饱和脂肪大于每100毫升3.0克。 • 每100毫升大于100毫克的钠。

blocks.en: total sugar greater than 5.0 g per 100 ml.

blocks.en: saturated fat greater than 3.0 g per 100 ml.
blocks.zh: 饱和脂肪大于每100毫升3.0克.

blocks.en: sodium greater than 100 mg per 100 ml.
blocks.zh: 每100毫升大于100毫克的钠.

blocks.en: The artificial-sweetener criterion requires explicit evidence of an added artificial sweetener and does not require a corresponding nutrient-table value [ 7 ] . The accepted nutrition, ingredient and product-form evidence is then mapped to one of four product-level screening outcomes. Warning criteria met indicates that the available and accepted evidence satisfies at least one encoded draft R3337 warning criterion. It does not indicate that a warning symbol was visually detected on the package. No warning criteria triggered indicates that the available and accepted evidence is sufficient for screening but does not establish an encoded warning criterion and is not interpreted as confirmation of legal compliance. Review indicates that relevant evidence is available but remains uncertain, ambiguous or conflicting, while Insufficient evidence indicates that evidence required to apply the screening rules is unavailable. Review and Insufficient evidence represent abstention outcomes rather than forced automatic decisions. Qualifying unresolved evidence from the abstention outcomes proceeds to the selective VLM evidence-review stage described in Section 4.5.
blocks.zh: 人工增温标准要求明确证明添加的人工增温剂,不要求相应的营养表值[7]. 然后将公认的营养、成分和产品形式证据绘制成四种产品一级筛选结果之一。 达到的警告标准表明,现有和接受的证据至少符合一个编码的R3337预警标准草案。 它没有表明在包件上检测到一个警告符号。 没有触发的警告标准表明现有和接受的证据足以进行筛选,但没有确立编码的警告标准,也没有被解释为对法律遵守情况的确认。 审查表明,存在相关证据,但仍然不确定、含糊或相互矛盾,而证据不足表明,没有适用筛选规则所需的证据。 审查和证据不足是弃权结果,而不是强制自动决定。 将弃权结果中未解决的证据定性,进入第4.5节所描述的有选择的自愿核实、核实和核实证据审查阶段。

blocks.en: 4.5 Selective Vision-Language Model Evidence Review
blocks.zh: 4.5 选择性远景-语言模型证据审查

blocks.en: Existing automatic rules-only outcomes are not reconsidered. Figure 2 presents the six-stage selective VLM evidence-review process for qualifying rules-only abstentions.
blocks.zh: 现有仅按规则办事的自动结果不予重新审议。 图2列出仅限规则弃权资格的六阶段选择性VLM证据审查程序。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Selective VLM evidence-review and rule-reapplication workflow.
blocks.zh: 图2:选择性VLM证据审查及规则重用工作流程.

blocks.en: 1. Select eligible cases. Products assigned Review or Insufficient evidence proceed to VLM review only when they contain qualifying unresolved nutrition, ingredient or product-form evidence. 2. Select image evidence. Relevant nutrition-panel, ingredient-list or product-identity crops are selected for the unresolved evidence. The VLM reassesses this evidence rather than making an independent product-level screening decision. 3. Task-specific VLM review. The same Qwen3-VL 8B Instruct model is used through separate task-specific review routines for nutrition evidence, ingredient evidence and product form. The nutrition review examines unresolved nutrient values, units and reference bases. The ingredient review examines added sugar, added sodium, added saturated-fat sources and artificial sweeteners, while the product-form review assesses whether package evidence supports a solid or liquid classification. 4. Parse and merge VLM evidence. Each task-specific review returns a structured machine-readable response. Malformed, incomplete or unresolved responses are rejected, and structurally usable responses are not assumed to be factually correct. Under the evidence-merge rules, accepted VLM evidence supplements only absent or unresolved fields, while existing accepted rules-only evidence is retained. 5. Reapply rules. The merged evidence is reassessed using the same deterministic draft R3337 rules in Section 4.4. Existing evidence requirements are retained, so a VLM-recovered nutrient value cannot establish a sugar, sodium or saturated-fat warning without the corresponding qualifying ingredient evidence. 6. Post-review rule-based outcomes. Rule reapplication produces the post-review product-level outcome. Unresolved cases continue to abstain rather than being forced into an automatic outcome. Post-review outcomes are retained separately from initial rules-only outcomes for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 选择符合条件的案例. 只有在含有合格未解决的营养、成分或产品形式证据时,审查或证据不足才进行自愿终止措施审查。 2. 选择图像证据。 相关营养小板、成份清单或产品标识的作物被选用于未解决的证据。 VLM重新评估这些证据,而不是做出独立的产品级筛选决定. 3. 针对具体任务的自愿结束活动审查。 相同的Qwen3-VL 8B指令模型通过单独的任务特定审查常规用于营养证据,成分证据和产品形式. 营养审查审查了尚未解决的营养值、单位和参考依据。 成分审查检查添加的糖,添加的钠,添加的饱和脂肪源和人工甜剂,而产品形式审查则评估包装证据是否支持固体或液体分类. 4. 分析和合并VLM证据。 每次任务特定审查都返回结构化的机读响应. 错误的、不完整的或未解决的答复被否决,结构上可用的答复被认为不属实。 根据证据合并规则,被接受的VLM证据只能补充缺失或未解决的领域,而现有的被接受的只有规则的证据则保留. 5. 重新适用规则。 第4.4节使用同样的R3337规则草案对合并证据进行重新评估。 现有的证据要求被保留,因此VLM回收的养分值无法在没有相应的合格成分证据的情况下建立糖,钠或饱和脂肪警告. 6. 审查后基于规则的结果。 规则的重新应用产生审查后产品一级的结果。 未解决的案件继续弃权,而不是被迫自动产生结果。 后审查的结果与最初的只有规则的评价结果分开保留。

blocks.zh: 事后审查基于规则的结果。 规则的重新应用产生审查后产品一级的结果。 未解决的案件继续弃权,而不是被迫自动产生结果。 后审查的结果与最初的只有规则的评价结果分开保留。

blocks.en: During development, Phi-3.5-Vision Instruct [ 1 ] and Qwen3-VL 8B Instruct [ 4 ] were examined. Neither model was trained or fine-tuned in this study. Both pretrained models were used for inference. Phi-3.5-Vision Instruct was used only during exploratory testing and was not retained after producing confident but incorrect associations between nutrition-table rows and values. Qwen3-VL 8B Instruct was retained for the final evidence-review experiments and deployed locally through Ollama. Manual reference outcomes are withheld during VLM review, evidence merging and deterministic rule reapplication and are used only during evaluation. The factual correctness of structurally usable VLM evidence is evaluated separately using the evidence-level measures in Section 4.6.
blocks.zh: 开发期间,Phi-3.5-Vision指示[1]和Qun3-VL 8B 指示[4]经过审查。 在这项研究中,两个模型都没有经过培训或微调。 两个预先训练过的模型都用于推论. Phi-3.5-视觉 指令仅在探索性测试中使用,在营养表列和数值之间产生自信但不正确的关联后没有被保留. Qune3-VL 8B 指令被保留用于最后的证据审查实验,并通过Ollama在当地部署. 人工参考结果在VLM审查、证据合并和确定性规则重新适用期间不予采用,仅在评价期间使用。 利用第4.6节中的证据层面措施,分别评估结构上可使用的VLM证据的事实正确性。

blocks.en: 4.6 Manual Validation and Evaluation Measures
blocks.zh: 4.6 人工验证和评价措施

blocks.en: A 65-product manual validation set is constructed using stratified sampling across the four initial rules-only outcome categories. The set contains 22 randomly selected products assigned Warning criteria met , nine products assigned No warning criteria triggered , 17 randomly selected products assigned Review and 17 randomly selected products assigned Insufficient evidence . These rules-only outcomes are used only as sampling strata rather than as manual reference outcomes. The validation set is not intended to estimate the prevalence of the four outcome categories in the complete dataset. Manual reference review uses all available full-package photographs for each product and applies the same operational draft R3337 screening protocol described in Section 4.4. Reference outcomes are assigned from the complete visible package evidence.
blocks.zh: 采用分层抽样方法,构建了一套65种产品人工验证系统,涵盖4个只按规则进行的初步结果类别。 该套产品包含22个随机选择的产品指定了警告标准,9个被指定了警告标准没有触发,17个随机选择的产品指定了审查,17个随机选择的产品指定了证据不足。 这些只有规则才能产生的结果只用作抽样等级,而不是人工参考结果。 验证组无意估计整套数据集中四个结果类别的普遍程度。 人工参考审查对每种产品使用所有可用的全包装照片,并适用第4.4节所述的同样可操作的R3337筛选协议草案。 参考结果来自完整的可见包证据。

blocks.en: Where a complete and readable ingredient declaration establishes that none of the qualifying ingredient conditions is present, manual review can assign No warning criteria triggered even when the corresponding nutrient values are unavailable. This differs from the automated Not detected ingredient result in Section 4.3, which indicates only that no configured qualifying term was recovered from OCR-derived text and is not treated as proof of absence.
blocks.zh: 如果一份完整和可读的成分申报证明不存在任何合格成分条件,则可以进行人工审查。 即使没有相应的营养值,也没有触发警告标准。 这不同于第4.3节中自动检测到的未检测成份,该节仅表明没有从OCR衍生文本中收回任何已配置的合格术语,不被视为缺勤证明。

blocks.en: Manual review assigns 37 products to Warning criteria met , 23 to No warning criteria triggered and five to Insufficient evidence , resulting in 60 manually decidable products. The five unresolved products lack the evidence required for a definitive reference outcome after all available package images are examined. Product-specific evidence sources, reasons for unresolved outcomes and evidence-level reference fields for nutrition values, ingredient evidence and product form are recorded. All manual reference information is withheld from the rules-only workflow, selective VLM review and deterministic rule reapplication and is used only during evaluation.
blocks.zh: 人工审查为达到警告标准的产品分配了37种,未触发警告标准的产品分配了23种,证据不足的产品分配了5种,导致60种可人工判定的产品。 5个未解决的产品缺乏在审查了所有可用的包件图像后得出明确参考结果所需的证据。 记录具体产品的证据来源、未解决结果的原因以及营养值、成分证据和产品形式的证据级参考领域。 所有手工参考信息都从只限规则的工作流程、选择性的VLM审查和确定规则的重新应用中扣留,只在评价期间使用。

blocks.en: Product-level evaluation is performed on the 60 manually decidable products using the following measures. To reflect uncertainty associated with the validation-set size, 95% Wilson confidence intervals (CIs) are reported for coverage and selective accuracy.
blocks.zh: 采用下列措施,对60种可人工确定产品进行产品级评价。 为了反映与验证-设定大小有关的不确定性,报告了95%的威尔逊置信间隔(CIs)的覆盖范围和选择性准确性.

blocks.en: • Coverage: the proportion of products assigned an automatic outcome, namely Warning criteria met or No warning criteria triggered . • Selective accuracy: the number of correct automatic outcomes divided by the total number of automatic outcomes, with abstentions excluded from the denominator. • Abstention rate: the proportion of products assigned Review or Insufficient evidence . • False warning: an automated Warning criteria met outcome when the manual reference is No warning criteria triggered . • Unsafe warning omission: an automated No warning criteria triggered outcome when the manual reference is Warning criteria met .
blocks.zh: • 支助 覆盖面:指定自动结果的产品比例,即达到警告标准或未触发警告标准。 选择准确性:正确的自动结果数量除以自动结果总数,从分母中排除弃权。 • 留置率:指定产品的比例审查或证据不足。 不安全警告省略: 自动 当手册中提及警告标准符合时,没有预警标准触发结果。

blocks.en: Coverage: the proportion of products assigned an automatic outcome, namely Warning criteria met or No warning criteria triggered .
blocks.zh: 覆盖面:指定自动结果的产品比例,即达到警告标准或未触发警告标准。

blocks.en: Selective accuracy: the number of correct automatic outcomes divided by the total number of automatic outcomes, with abstentions excluded from the denominator.
blocks.zh: 选择性精度:将正确的自动结果数除以自动结果总数,从分母中排除弃权.

blocks.en: Abstention rate: the proportion of products assigned Review or Insufficient evidence .
blocks.zh: 留置率:指定产品的比例

blocks.en: False warning: an automated Warning criteria met outcome when the manual reference is No warning criteria triggered .
blocks.zh: 假警告:当手动引用为未触发警告标准时,自动警告标准符合结果。

blocks.en: Unsafe warning omission: an automated No warning criteria triggered outcome when the manual reference is Warning criteria met .
blocks.zh: 不安全警告省略: 自动 当手册中提及警告标准符合时,没有预警标准触发结果。

blocks.en: Evidence-level VLM evaluation assesses usability and correctness for nutrition, ingredient and product-form evidence. Nutrition correctness requires agreement on the nutrient value, unit and reference basis, with strict exact matching also reported. Ingredient correctness is calculated among usable category decisions and product-form correctness among usable solid or liquid classifications.
blocks.zh: 证据级VLM评价评估营养、成分和产品形式证据的可用性和正确性。 营养正确性要求就营养值、单位和参考依据达成一致,并报告有严格的精确匹配。 在可使用的类别决定中计算出成分正确性,在可使用的固体或液体分类中计算出产品形式正确性。

blocks.en: 4.7 Computational Environment
blocks.zh: 4.7 计算环境

blocks.en: All computational experiments are conducted on the UWC High-Performance Computing Cluster. The GPU-enabled compute environment uses an AMD EPYC-Milan processor and an NVIDIA L4 GPU with approximately 23 GB of GPU memory. Evidence extraction, product-level aggregation and deterministic screening are implemented in Python 3.10.
blocks.zh: 所有计算实验都是在UWC高性能计算集群上进行的. GPU启用的计算环境使用AMD EMYC-米兰处理器和NVIDIA L4 GPU,其中GPU内存约23GB. Python 3.10中进行了证据提取、产品一级汇总和确定性筛选。

blocks.en: 5 Results and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5 成果和评价

blocks.en: 5.1 Region Detection and Evidence Availability
blocks.zh: 5.1 区域侦查和证据提供情况

blocks.en: On the validation and held-out test subsets, respectively, detector precision was 0.846 and 0.889, while recall was 0.774 and 0.952. Mean average precision (mAP) at an intersection-over-union (IoU) threshold of 0.50 was 0.810 and 0.947, while mAP averaged across IoU thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95 was 0.635 and 0.757. Validation and test results are reported separately, as validation performance informed checkpoint selection while the product-disjoint test subset was reserved for final evaluation. Full-dataset inference produced 4,552 crops from 3,106 images, comprising 1,976 product-identity, 1,383 ingredient-list and 1,193 nutrition-panel regions. At least one target region was detected for every product.
blocks.zh: 在验证和搁置试验子集上,探测器精度分别为0.846和0.889,而召回则分别为0.774和0.952. 在0.50的交叉式(IoU)阈值下,平均精度为0.810和0.947,而0.50至0.95的IoU阈值下,平均精度为0.635和0.75。 验证和测试结果单独报告,因为验证性能为检查站选择提供了依据,而产品-脱节测试子集则留给最后评价。 完整的数据集推论从3,106幅图像中产生了4,552种作物,包括1,976种产品标识、1,383种成分列表和1,193个营养小区。 在每个产品中至少检测到一个目标区域。

blocks.en: OCR processing was completed for all 4,552 detected crops, although not every crop contained usable recognised text. Processing the original and padded nutrition-panel renderings produced 2,386 crop-rendering records containing 82,682 recognised tokens. Tokens were recovered from 2,363 renderings, while 23 contained no recognised tokens. Structured nutrition evidence was recovered for 334 products. Accepted total-sugar evidence was available for 170 products, total-fat for 157, saturated-fat for 156, sodium for 158 and salt for four. Usable recognised ingredient text was available for 386 products. Fifty-four products had no detected ingredient-list region, while two had a detected ingredient region with no recognised text. Product-form assessment classified 222 products as Solid and 51 as Liquid , while 169 remained Review .
blocks.zh: 对所有4,552个经检测的作物完成了OCR处理,尽管并非所有作物都含有可使用的公认文字。 处理原始和添加营养小板的渲染,产生了2 386份作物投放记录,其中载有82 682个经确认的标志。 从2,363件渲染物中收回了托肯,而23件则没有确认的标志。 为334种产品找到了结构营养证据。 170种产品有接受的总糖证据,157种总脂肪,156种饱和脂肪,158种钠,4种盐。 386种产品有可用的公认成份文本。 54种产品没有检测到的成份清单区域,而两种产品有一个检测到的成份区域,没有公认的文本。 产品形式评估将222种产品归类为固体产品,51种归类为液体产品,169种仍为审查产品。

blocks.en: 5.2 Rules-Only Product-Level Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 规则 -- -- 只有产品一级的结果

blocks.en: Across all 442 products, the rules-only workflow produced 83 automatic outcomes, an operational decision rate of 18.8%, and abstained on 359 products. These full-dataset results describe workflow behaviour rather than accuracy, as the complete dataset was not manually validated. Among the 60 manually decidable validation products, the workflow produced 31 automatic outcomes, of which 30 agreed with the manual reference. This corresponded to 51.7% coverage (95% CI 39.3–63.8%) and 96.8% selective accuracy (95% CI 83.8–99.4%), while missing, uncertain or conflicting required evidence contributed to a 48.3% abstention rate. One false warning and no unsafe warning omissions were observed.
blocks.zh: 在所有442种产品中,只有规则的工作流程产生了83种自动结果,业务决策率为18.8%,359种产品投弃权票。 这些完整的数据集结果描述的是工作流程行为而非准确性,因为完整的数据集没有经过人工验证. 在60个可人工解析的验证产品中,工作流程产生了31个自动结果,其中30个与人工参考一致. 这相当于51.7%的覆盖率(95%的CI 39.3-63.8%)和96.8%的选择性精确度(95%的CI 83.8-99.4%),而缺失、不确定或相互矛盾的所需证据导致48.3%的弃权率。 发现有一个错误的警告,没有不安全的警告遗漏。

blocks.en: 5.3 Product-Level Results After Selective VLM Review
blocks.zh: 5.3 选择VLM后的产品级结果 审查

blocks.en: Of the 359 products on which the rules-only workflow abstained, accepted Qwen3-VL evidence was incorporated for 232 products under the evidence-merge rules. Existing automatic rules-only outcomes remained unchanged. After evidence merging and rule reapplication, the product-level outcome changed for 144 products. Ninety-four abstentions became automatic outcomes, while 50 products moved between Review and Insufficient evidence . Across the dataset, the operational decision rate increased from 18.8% to 40.0%. These changes describe workflow behaviour rather than accuracy, as the dataset was not manually validated.
blocks.zh: 在仅按规则工作流程投弃权票的359个产品中,232个产品根据证据汇总规则纳入了接受的Qune3-VL证据。 现有的仅按规则办事的自动结果保持不变。 在证据合并和规则重新应用之后,对144种产品而言,产品一级的结果发生了变化。 94票弃权成为自动结果,50个产品在审查与证据不足之间移动。 在整个数据集中,业务决策率从18.8%上升到40.0%。 这些变化描述的是工作流程行为而非准确性,因为数据集没有经过人工验证.

blocks.en: Among the 60 manually decidable validation products, selective VLM review resolved eight additional cases, increasing coverage to 65.0% (95% CI 52.4–75.8%) and reducing the abstention rate from 48.3% to 35.0%. Overall, 38 of 39 automatic outcomes agreed with the manual reference, giving 97.4% selective accuracy (95% CI 86.8–99.5%). The single false warning remained from the rules-only workflow, with no unsafe warning omissions after selective review. Tables 1 and 2 summarise the full-dataset outcome changes and validation-set performance, respectively.
blocks.zh: 在60种可人工判定的验证产品中,选择性的VLM审查解决了另外8个案例,将覆盖率提高到65.0%(95%CI 52.4–75.8%),并将弃权率从48.3%降至35.0%。 总体而言,39项自动结果中有38项与人工参考一致,给予97.4%的选择性精确度(95% CI 86.8-99.5)。 单一的虚假警告仍然来自只遵守规则的工作流程,经过选择性审查后没有不安全的警告遗漏。 表1和表2分别汇总了完整的数据集结果变化和验证-设定性能.

blocks.zh: 5.4 证据层面的可靠性

blocks.en: 5.5 Case Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.5 案件分析

blocks.en: Selected validation products illustrate how VLM-recovered evidence affected product-level outcomes and are not intended to represent the full validation set or complete dataset. For SaveMor Coconut Biscuits, the VLM recovered total sugar as 17.8 g per 100 g, matching the manual reference value, while qualifying added-sugar evidence supported a Warning criteria met outcome through the sugar criterion. SPAR Split Peas illustrates that a correct product-level outcome can still contain incorrect recovered evidence. The VLM recovered total sugar as 0.7 g per 100 g, while manual review recorded 2.7 g per 100 g. Both values were below the applicable solid-product threshold, so the error did not alter the final No warning criteria triggered outcome. A similar sugar-extraction error could affect the product-level outcome if the correct value exceeded the applicable threshold and qualifying added-sugar evidence was present. These cases show why product-level performance should be interpreted alongside evidence-level correctness.
blocks.zh: 部分验证产品说明了VLM回收的证据如何影响产品一级的结果,并非意在代表完整的验证集或完整的数据集. 对于SaveMor Coconut Biscuits,VLM回收的糖总含量为每100克17.8克,与手动参考值相匹配,而合格加糖证据支持通过糖标准满足结果的警告标准. SPAR Split Peas表明,正确的产品级结果仍然可能包含不正确的收回证据. VLM回收的糖总含量为每100克0.7克,而人工审查记录为每100克2.7克。 这两种数值都低于适用的固体产品阈值,因此误差没有改变最终的“无预警标准”触发结果。 如果有正确的价值超过适用的阈值和合格加糖证据,类似的糖-糖提取错误可能影响产品一级的结果。 这些案件表明,为什么产品一级的性能应该与证据一级的正确性一并解释。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 6.1 Evidence Recovery Limited Automatic Coverage
blocks.zh: 6.1 证据回收有限自动覆盖

blocks.en: Despite strong held-out detector performance, automatic coverage was limited by incomplete nutrition, ingredient and product-form evidence. These limitations are consistent with the packaging-specific OCR challenges reported by Nagayi et al. [ 16 ] and the broader image-condition challenges identified by Guimarães et al. [ 11 ] . Manual review also encountered blurred sections and visible skew, although their effect on individual extraction errors was not isolated. Region localisation restricted OCR to detected package areas, following the detection-before-recognition approach used by Saputra et al. [ 18 ] . Structured screening also required nutrient labels to be associated with the correct values, units and reference bases, reflecting the importance of spatial association demonstrated by Fuentes et al. [ 9 ] , while ingredient and product-form uncertainty introduced further abstentions. These findings support retaining unresolved cases rather than treating missing or uncertain evidence as a negative result.
blocks.zh: 尽管有很强的阻断探测器性能,但由于营养、成分和产品形式的证据不足,自动覆盖范围受到限制。 这些限制与Nagayi等人报告的特定包装的OCR挑战是一致的。 [16] 和Guimarães等人确定的更广泛的形象条件挑战。 [11]. 人工审查还遇到模糊的章节和可见的skew,尽管它们对个别提取错误的影响并不是孤立的. 区域定位将OCR限制在检测到的包裹区域,遵循Saputra等人采用的检测前识别方法[18]. 结构化筛选还需要将营养物标签与正确的值,单位和参考基础联系起来,以反映Fuentes等人所证明的空间关联的重要性. [9],而成分和产品形式的不确定性则导致进一步弃权。 这些调查结果支持保留未决案件,而不是将失踪或不确定的证据视为负面结果。

blocks.en: 6.2 Coverage, Selective Accuracy and Abstention
blocks.zh: 6.2 覆盖范围、选择性准确性和弃权

blocks.en: Selective VLM review resolved eight additional validation products without introducing a new false warning or unsafe warning omission. The small number of resolved cases, however, limits broader conclusions about this improvement. Geifman and El-Yaniv [ 10 ] examined coverage and error risk in selective prediction, while Whitehead et al. [ 19 ] showed the value of abstaining when confidence is insufficient in visual question answering. In this workflow, abstention is determined by deterministic evidence requirements rather than a probabilistic confidence score, so confidence calibration was not evaluated. The rules-only and post-review results provide two operating points for the coverage-abstention trade-off, but not a full risk-coverage curve. Coverage should therefore be interpreted together with selective accuracy and error type.
blocks.zh: 选择性VLM审查解决了8个额外的验证产品,没有引入新的虚假警告或不安全的警告遗漏. 然而,已解决的案件数量少,限制了关于这一改进的更广泛结论。 Geifman和El-Yaniv [10] 审查了选择性预测中的覆盖范围和误差风险,而Whitehead等人则审查了这些风险。 [19] 显示了在信心不足的视觉问题回答时弃权的价值。 在这个工作流程中,弃权是由确定性的证据要求决定的,而不是一个概率性信心分数,因此信心校准没有被评价. 只有规则和审查后的结果为覆盖-取消权衡提供了两个操作点,但并不是完整的风险覆盖曲线. 因此,应结合选择性准确性和错误类型来解释覆盖范围。

blocks.en: 6.3 Benefits and Risks of Vision-Language Evidence Review
blocks.zh: 6.3 愿景-语言证据审查的益处和风险

blocks.en: Selective VLM review recovered useful evidence for some unresolved cases, but reliability varied across nutrition, ingredient and product-form tasks. Nutrition evidence showed the lowest correctness of the three evaluated evidence types, indicating that exact nutrient recovery remained more difficult than the broader ingredient and product-form decisions in this evaluation. The case analysis also showed that an incorrect recovered nutrient value could coexist with a correct product-level outcome when the error did not change the applicable warning criterion. This distinction is important, as high selective accuracy at product level does not establish that all supporting evidence is correct. Liu et al. [ 13 ] similarly reported useful multimodal text-recognition capabilities alongside continuing weaknesses on challenging text-related image tasks, while Assiri et al. [ 3 ] demonstrated the applicability of multimodal models to nutrition extraction from food-label images. The causes of individual VLM errors were not isolated in this study, so the observed errors cannot be attributed to a single failure source. The evidence-level results therefore support retaining the VLM as a selective evidence reviewer rather than an independent product-level decision-maker.
blocks.zh: 选择性VLM审查为一些未解决的案件找到了有用的证据,但可靠性因营养、成分和产品形式而异。 营养证据表明,三种评估证据类型中准确性最低,表明准确的营养恢复仍然比本次评估中更广泛的成分和产品形式决定更为困难。 案例分析还表明,如果错误没有改变适用的警告标准,不正确的恢复营养值可以与正确的产品级结果共存。 这种区分很重要,因为产品一级的高选择性精度不能证明所有佐证证据都是正确的。 刘等. [13] 同样报告了有用的多式联运文本识别能力,与此同时,在挑战文本相关图像任务方面仍存在薄弱环节,而Assiri等人则报告了这一点。 [3] 证明了多式联运模式适用于从食品标签图像中提取营养。 本研究没有将单个VLM错误的原因隔离开来,因此观察到的错误不能归结为单一的故障源. 因此,证据层面的结果支持保留自愿交易清单作为选择性证据审查者,而不是独立的产品层面决策者。

blocks.en: 6.4 Relationship to Manual Draft R3337 Assessment
blocks.zh: 6.4 与R3337评估草案手册的关系

blocks.en: Unlike the draft R3337 assessments of Abdool Karim et al. [ 2 ] and Mamabolo et al. [ 14 ] , which used captured or manually coded product information, this study addresses evidence recovery directly from food-package photographs. The workflow therefore supports screening rather than automated regulatory assessment, and a No warning criteria triggered outcome does not establish legal compliance.
blocks.zh: 与对Abdool Karim等人[2]和Mamabolo等人[14]的R3337评估草案不同,该评估草案使用了捕获或手动编码的产品信息,本研究直接涉及从食品包装照片中提取的证据。 因此,工作流程支持筛选,而不是自动化的监管评估,任何触发的预警标准不能确立法律合规性。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: The stratified 65-product validation set was not designed to estimate outcome prevalence, and five products remained unresolved after all package images had been reviewed. The same set supported product-level and evidence-level evaluation, while post-review outcomes for the 442-product dataset were not manually verified. Structurally usable VLM outputs could contain incorrect evidence. Broader evaluation using an independent dataset and systematic error-sensitivity analysis is therefore needed to assess robustness and generalisation. Evidence availability differed across nutrition, ingredient and product-form information, with limitations in nutrient-row association, ingredient recovery and unclear preparation or product-form evidence. Salt evidence was particularly scarce. The study used one South African food-package image collection, so generalisation to other products, retailers, languages and image conditions remains untested. The study did not include a full-image OCR baseline and therefore does not isolate the effect of region localisation. R3337 remained in draft form at the time of the study, and its criteria may change before the regulations are finalised. The final evidence-review evaluation used one retained VLM, so the findings do not establish generalisability across different VLMs. The dataset cannot be publicly released as it forms part of an ongoing project, while the code is available on request from the corresponding author.
blocks.zh: 分级的65个产品验证集不是用来估计结果普及率的,在审查了所有成套图像之后,有5个产品仍未解决。 同一套数据支持产品一级和证据一级评价,而442个产品数据集的审查后结果没有经过人工核实。 结构上可以使用的VLM输出可能包含不正确的证据. 因此,需要利用独立的数据集和系统的错误敏感性分析进行更广泛的评价,以评估稳健性和普遍性。 不同营养、成份和产品形式信息的证据提供情况不同,在养分序列、成份回收和制备或产品形式证据不明确方面存在局限性。 盐的证据特别少。 该研究使用了南非的食品包装图象收集,因此,对其他产品、零售商、语言和图象条件的概括仍然没有经过测试。 该研究没有包括完整的图像OCR基线,因此没有隔离区域本地化的影响. 研究时,R3337仍为草案形式,其标准在规章定稿前可能有所改变. 最后的证据审查评价使用了一个保留VLM,因此结论没有确定不同VLM的通用性. 数据集不能公开发布,因为它构成一个正在进行的项目的一部分,而代码则是应相应作者的要求提供的.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: This study developed and evaluated a region-guided, abstention-aware workflow for draft R3337 screening from South African food-package photographs. On the 60 manually decidable validation products, rules-only screening achieved 51.7% coverage and 96.8% selective accuracy, while selective Qwen3-VL 8B Instruct review increased coverage to 65.0% and selective accuracy to 97.4%, with one false warning and no unsafe warning omissions. Evidence-level evaluation showed that structurally usable VLM outputs could still contain incorrect supporting evidence. Selective VLM review can therefore supplement unresolved evidence, while deterministic rule reapplication and explicit abstention remain important. Further work should evaluate cross-checking between OCR-derived and VLM-recovered evidence, agreement across multiple VLMs, and improved nutrition-row association, ingredient recovery and product-form determination. The workflow provides decision support rather than final legal or regulatory determinations.
blocks.zh: 这项研究为南非食品包装照片中的R3337筛选草案制定并评价了一个区域指导的、不知情的工作流程。 在60个可人工解析的验证产品上,只限规则的筛选达到了51.7%的覆盖率和96.8%的选择性精度,而选择性的Qune3-VL 8B指令审查则将覆盖率提高到65.0%,选择性精度提高到97.4%,同时有一个虚假的警告,没有不安全的警告遗漏. 证据层面的评价表明,结构上可以使用的VLM产出仍然可能含有不正确的佐证证据。 因此,选择性VLM审查可以补充尚未解决的证据,而确定性规则的重新适用和明确弃权仍然很重要。 进一步的工作应评价OCR派生证据和VLM派生证据之间的交叉核对、多种VLM之间的一致以及改善营养层联系、成分回收和产品形式确定。 工作流程提供决策支持,而不是最终的法律或监管决定。
